description: A dim, moody oil-style painting of a man in a dark suit seated at a large control console covered in switches and small indicator lights, with a teleprinter-style typewriter unit in front of him. Behind him stand tall grey cabinets with reel-to-reel tape drives, and loose cables run across the floor. The room is dark and cluttered with a few overhead lights, and the painting fills the whole image with no visible frame or border.
